import { Base } from './base.ts'
const ratio = width / height / 2; const q = "'{"
export class Shape extends Base implements Drawable, Sized {
  private secret: string
  #hidden = 1
  protected guard(x: number): boolean { return x > 0 }
  public name: string = 'shape'
  static create(a: number, b: { c: string }): Shape { return new Shape() }
  area = (scale: number): number => { return scale }
  constructor(n: number) { super(n) }
}
export abstract class Animal {
  abstract speak(): void
  readonly legs?: number
}
class Hidden { x: number }
export interface Drawable extends Base, Other<string> {
  draw(ctx: Ctx): void
  label?: string
  onClick: (e: Event) => void
  [key: string]: unknown
}
export type Options = {
  width: number
  cb(x: number): string
}
export type Kind = 'a' | 'b'
export enum Color { Red = 'red', Green = 2, Blue }
export function plain(a: string): number { return 1 }
export async function later(): Promise<void> {}
export const arrow = (x: number, y: number) => x / y
export const N = 3
export const veryLongName = (alpha: string, beta: number, gamma: Record<string, Array<number>>, delta: boolean) => alpha
